summation.displayName: Phosphorylation of CEBPB (C/EBP-beta) transcription factor o...
summation.text: Phosphorylation of CEBPB (C/EBP-beta) transcription factor on threonine residue T235 happens downstream of activated RAS, is mediated by MAPKs - likely MAPK3 (ERK1) and MAPK1 (ERK2), and positively affects CEBPB-mediated transcription of IL6 (Nakajima et al. 1993).
